title: Flipping output preserves space use
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols and $k$ work tapes, let $x$ and $w$ be Boolean words, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. The space used by the machine with flipped output, when run under $w$ from the configuration obtained by flipping every output bit of $c$, equals the space used by $M$ when run under $w$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with Boolean symbols and k work tapes
